_comment: The qualified Experiment III capture host, bound for A5/P1. Identical apparatus to capture_runtime_wsl2_linux.json -- same runtime tree, same JDK, same Xvfb, same Mesa llvmpipe -- and differing in exactly one field: output_root. P0's episodes land in docs/experiment_iii/p0, which is banked immutable scientific evidence under authority 7.8; a P1 episode written there would mutate it. P1 episodes therefore land in their own root and the two stages can never collide.
